text.text_excerpt: This was such a wonderful event! My sister went to Cookies and Cocktails two years ago and loved it, so I thought I would give it a try this year. The Food: Now, I will say, I broke my gluten-free laws for this event but it was well worth it. The food was delicious, the drinks were amazing, and the samples was perfectly portioned so I could eat EVERYTHING. Unlike some other tastings, I was actually full after all of my tastes. Even my guest who didn't eat dinner prior to coming left feeling satisfied. It also gave me the opportunity to try restaurants that I haven't yet been to, and now will definitely be a regular. What a fun evening! I love both Girl Scout cookies and cocktails so really this was an event made with my tastebuds in my mind. I loved the layout of the event, it was super easy to get around and there was a ton of space to move around in, which is always nice at events like these. Plus places to sit, yay! Both the libations and the food choices were tasty. My favorite cocktail was from the Crescent City Bartending School and featured a delicious twist on adult lemonade ( and it was pretty fancy pants too)! I loooved Seed's food offering, although I wished there had been more since I could have eaten a dozen of those "crab" cakes! I do wish there had been a few more savory options availa...

Thank you SO MUCH Yelp and my buddy Cassandra for inviting me to be her +1 to this event! I was a Girl Scout for 13 years and felt this was a cause near and dear to my heart. Strangely enough, I had not eaten any GS cookies in several years...don't know how or why, sometimes these things just get away from me. But I got my fill at this event!
